zh_CN: 很久以前，这片土地上没有国王，
en: Long ago this country had no king.

zh_CN: 每一座都有自己的城墙，每一座都认定自己最好。
en: each behind its own wall, and each quite sure it was the best of them.

zh_CN: 他们为过路钱和界石吵架，
en: They quarrelled over tolls and boundary stones,

zh_CN: 每到收获的时候，总要去赶彼此的集市。
en: and at every harvest they came to one another's fairs.

zh_CN: 后来有一年秋天，雪早早地从北方下来了。
en: Then one autumn the snow came early out of the north.

zh_CN: 到第三年，钟已经不再为死者敲响，
en: By the third year the bells had stopped ringing for the dead,

zh_CN: 就在那一年，运粮的车队从南方来了，
en: That was the year the grain wagons came up from the south,

zh_CN: 打着一面谁也没见过的旗。
en: under a banner no one knew.

zh_CN: 哪座城肯打开城门、挂上这面旗，哪座城就有面包吃；
en: There was bread for any town that would open its gates and hang that banner;

zh_CN: 而每一座开了门的城，都得连钟和种粮一起交出去，
en: and every town that did gave up its bell and its seed corn with it,
and could never again feed itself.

zh_CN: 最后一座不肯低头的城，被攻了下来。
en: The last town that held out was taken by storm.

zh_CN: 守城的人被吊死在自家的城墙上，
en: Its defenders were hanged from their own walls,

zh_CN: 城里的人被赶进了雪地。
en: and its people turned out into the snow.
That was the beginning of the Empire;
and the Empire rules by the winter.

zh_CN: 交出儿子、交出劳力的村子，
en: The village that gives up its sons and its labour

zh_CN: 藏了一把种粮的、跪得慢了的村子，什么也得不到：
en: The village that hides a handful of seed, or is slow to kneel, is sent none:
and the snow does the rest.
So it has gone for a hundred years.

zh_CN: 可是今夜，帝国每一座城的钟都在响，
en: But tonight the bells are ringing in every town of the Empire,

zh_CN: 帝国看守的一样东西被人拿走了：
en: Something has been taken from the Empire's keeping:
the secret of how the winter may be withstood.
And the Empire will have it back,

zh_CN: 哪怕把每一户人家都翻个底朝天。
en: if it must turn out every house to find it.

zh_CN:
帝国出现之前，世上没有帝国。
只有一座座自由城镇：各有各的城墙，各有各的田地，各有各的纷争，除了自己，不奉任何人为主。
en:
Before the Empire, there was no empire.
There were the free towns: each with its own walls, its own fields, its own quarrels, and no master but itself.

zh_CN:
然后，白冬来了。春天不化的雪，直到盛夏仍是一片白的田野。
它年复一年向这片土地蔓延，每一年都走得更远一点，夺走得更多一点。
en:
Then came the White Winter. Snow that would not melt in spring. Fields that lay white into midsummer.
And every year it crept a little further across the land, and took a little more.

zh_CN:
有一个人看懂了这场冬天能拿来做什么。雪落到哪里，他就带着运粮车和长矛跟到哪里。
饥饿的城镇为面包打开城门，他便把它们的名字写上自己的地图。
en:
One man understood what the winter was for. Wherever the snow fell, he followed it with grain wagons and spears.
Starving towns opened their gates for bread, and he wrote their names upon his map.

zh_CN:
一座又一座，地图被填满了。那人为自己加冕，称帝。
从那以后，白冬一直在为他的家族效力：帝国的粮食到不了的地方，什么也长不出来。
en:
Town by town, the map was filled. The man crowned himself Emperor.
And the White Winter has served his house ever since: where the Empire's grain does not go, nothing grows.

zh_CN:
如今，在那张地图参差的边缘，一个人正在逃命，身后是骑手和他们的猎狗。
他身上带着一样从帝国手里拿走的东西，帝国非把它找回来不可。
en:
Now, at the ragged edge of that map, a man runs for his life, with riders and their dogs behind him.
He carries something taken from the Empire's keeping, and the Empire means to have it back.

zh_CN: 把“你”拖到黑刺李林上，走进去。
林子里有人。把“你”拖到他身上。
en: Someone is in the wood. Drag yourself onto him.

zh_CN: 顺着溪水走：把“你”拖到溪边小道上。
en: Follow the stream: drag yourself onto Brookside.

zh_CN: 信使追上来了。把“你”拖到他身上。
en: The Messenger has caught you up. Drag yourself onto him.

zh_CN: 哈……哈……不行了。真不行了，一步也走不动了。
en: Hah… hah… No. No more. Not one more step.

zh_CN: 天啊，好累……多久没合眼了？两夜？还是三夜？
en: God, I'm tired. …How long since I slept? Two nights? Three?

zh_CN: 脚……我已经感觉不到自己的脚了。
en: My feet… I can't feel my feet any more.

zh_CN: 狗叫声也听不见了。也许……跟丢了？不。他们不会停下的。
en: Can't hear the dogs any more, either. Maybe… they've lost me? No. They won't stop.

zh_CN: 是地。黑泥，枯草，湿头发似的贴在地上。……是草啊。
en: Ground. Black mud. Dead grass, flat as wet hair. …Grass.

zh_CN: 雪……到这儿就停了？不可能。雪从来只进不退。
en: The snow… it stops here? It can't. The snow never gives ground.

zh_CN: 啊……这是什么地方？我到底跑到哪儿来了？
en: Ah… what is this place? Where have I run to?

zh_CN: 这灌木……密得像堵墙，底下黑得像口井。
en: These thorns… thick as a wall, and black as a well underneath.

zh_CN: 马……应该钻不进去吧？狗呢？地这么湿，它们还闻得出我的气味吗？
en: A horse… couldn't get through that, could it? And the dogs? Ground this wet, could they still pick up my scent?

zh_CN: 不过……要是我能钻进去呢？
en: Still… what if I could get in?

zh_CN: 说不定，他们就找不着我了。说不定。
en: They might lose me. They just might.

zh_CN: 你拨开刺枝钻了进去。脚下的地越来越软。身后某处，一根树枝咔地断了。你屏住呼吸，直到确定那只是树皮冻裂的声音。
en: You push in through the thorn. The ground goes soft underfoot, then softer. Somewhere behind you a branch cracks. You stop breathing until you are sure it was only bark splitting in the frost.

zh_CN: 树缝里有光。是灯，还是水面映着月亮？你已经分不清了。
en: Light between the trees. Lanterns, or water catching the moon? You can't tell any more.

zh_CN: 你的左手抖个不停。你把它塞进外套里按住，像按住别人的手。
en: Your left hand won't stop shaking. You push it into your coat and hold it there, as if it belonged to someone else.

zh_CN: 然后树木合拢过来，一片白雾横在你面前，低低的，一动不动。
en: Then the trees close in, and a bank of white mist lies across your path, low and still.

zh_CN: 前方的雾里有东西在动。你停下。它也停下。
en: Something moves in the mist ahead. You stop. So does it.

zh_CN: 一个人那么高的影子。腰间闪过一点黄铜。
en: A shape, man-high. A glint of brass at its belt.

zh_CN: 你把自己缩得很小。没什么用。
en: You make yourself very small. It doesn't help.
I can see you, you know.

zh_CN: 你的手摸到一块石头，攥紧了。
en: Your hand finds a stone and closes on it.

zh_CN: 求你别。我今天已经够累了。
en: Please don't. I've had a long day.

zh_CN: 一个不值得你扔石头的人。
一个年轻人从雾里走出来，喘着粗气。头发上别着月桂，腰间挎着信包。
en: A young man steps out of the mist, breathing hard. Laurel in his hair, a satchel of letters at his hip.

zh_CN: 派我？大概是送信这份差事吧。信又不会自己走路，真可惜。
en: Sent me? The post, I suppose. Letters don't walk by themselves, more's the pity.

zh_CN: 他把你打量了一遍：头发上的霜，靴子的惨状。笑意收了些，换成一种小心。
en: He looks you over: the frost in your hair, the state of your boots. His smile thins into something more careful.

zh_CN: 你是从雪里走出来的？靠两条腿？
en: You've come out of the snow? On foot?

zh_CN: 不怎样。只是从那边来的人，多半走不到这儿。
en: Nothing of it. Only that people who come that way don't usually arrive.

zh_CN: 他等着你往下说。可你没有接下去。
en: He waits for you to go on, but you leave it there.

zh_CN: 啊，那正好。找到这地方最好的法子就是迷路。没人是特意来的。
en: Ah, well. Best way to find the place. Nobody gets here on purpose.

zh_CN: 他递过来一只水壶，壶身上錾着一对黄铜翅膀。
en: He holds out a flask worked with a pair of brass wings.

zh_CN: 你接过来。手指冷得厉害，黄铜摸上去竟有点烫。
en: You take it. Your fingers are so cold the brass almost burns.

zh_CN: 他注意到了。不等你缩手，他的手就覆上来，连你的手一起握住壶身。
en: He notices. Before you can pull away, his hand closes over yours on the flask.

zh_CN: 圣徒在上。你冷得像块冰。
他的手带着赶路的热度。他一直握着，直到水壶不再发抖。
en: His hand is hot from the road. He holds on until the flask stops shaking.

zh_CN: 然后他第一次认真地看你。看你的脸，像是想认出什么。
en: Then he looks at you properly, for the first time. At your face, as if he were trying to place it.

zh_CN: 嗯……那大概是我认错人了。
en: Hm… no, I suppose not. My mistake.

zh_CN: 不知道？行吧，你想留点神秘，那就留着。
en: You don't know? All right. Keep your mystery, then.

zh_CN: 他由着你，也没有不高兴，只是把自己的手收了回去。
en: He lets you. He doesn't seem to mind; he just takes his own hand back.

zh_CN: 你回头望向来的方向。只有树，和树后面的一片白。
en: You look back the way you came. Only trees, and the white beyond them.

zh_CN: 那就好。我只有这一只水壶。
en: Good. I've only the one flask.

zh_CN: 好了。你不能在这儿过夜，就算在雪线这一边，夜里的寒气也要人命。前面不远就有个叫背风地的村子。
en: Right. You can't sleep out here. The cold comes down at night even this side of the snow. Not far on there's a village called the Lee.

zh_CN: 我得先给烧炭的老芬恩送封信。你顺着溪水的方向走，走不出一里地我就追上你。
en: I've a letter for old Finn the charcoal-burner first. Keep to the way the stream runs, and I'll catch you up before you've gone a mile.

zh_CN: 你还没来得及说你什么都没答应，他已经消失在树丛里了。水壶还在你手里。
en: He is gone between the trees before you can say you never agreed to anything. You are still holding his flask.

zh_CN: 不到一个钟头，他追了上来，膝盖以下全湿透了，一脸得意。
en: Within the hour he catches you up, soaked to the knee and pleased with himself.

zh_CN: 你在这儿啊。冻成那样的人，走得倒不慢。
en: There you are. You walk fast, for a man in that state.

zh_CN: 前面的树稀了。树后面升着炊烟，炊烟底下是一片屋顶。
en: Ahead the trees thin. Beyond them smoke is rising, and under the smoke there are roofs.

zh_CN: 看见了吧。那就是背风地。

en: Why… is there no snow here?
Snow? It hasn't come this far yet.

zh_CN: 再往南走，一辈子没见过雪的人多的是。
en: Go further south and there are plenty of folk who've never seen it in their lives.

zh_CN: 你低头看着脚下的泥地，半天没有说话。
en: You look down at the bare mud under your feet, and for a long moment you say nothing.

zh_CN: 走吧。再往前一点，草是绿的。
en: Come on. A little further on, the grass is green.

zh_CN: 不过你别一个人进村。大家都怕帝国找到这儿，冷不丁见了生面孔会慌。跟着我走。
en: Only don't walk in on your own. Everyone's afraid of the Empire finding this place, and a strange face out of nowhere would frighten them. Stay with me.

zh_CN: 他迈开步子，又猛地站住，你差点撞到他背上。他转过身，一只手扶住你的胳膊，就那么搭着没拿开。
en: He sets off, then stops so suddenly that you nearly walk into his back. He turns, catches your arm to steady you, and leaves his hand there.

zh_CN: 圣徒在上。我跟你说了这么半天，连你叫什么都没问。
en: Saints. I've been talking at you all this while and never asked your name.
{name}… I like it. You're good-looking, too.

zh_CN: 他的手还搭在你胳膊上。隔着袖子，你也觉得出那只手是热的。
en: His hand is still on your arm. Even through the sleeve you can feel the heat of it.

zh_CN: 他说着凑过来，离你的脸不到一掌远，认认真真地看。
en: As he says it he leans in, a hand's breadth from your face, and looks at you in earnest.

zh_CN: 怪了。我还是觉得在哪儿见过你。
en: Odd. I still think I've seen you somewhere.
{name}… No, never heard it. So I haven't, then.
Only then does he straighten up.

zh_CN: 你往后退了半步。他跟着迈上来半步，手还搭在你胳膊上。
en: You step back half a pace. He steps forward half a pace after you, his hand still on your arm.
Hm? What is it, are your legs going?
{name}. I'm Oisín. …Your ears have gone red with the cold.

zh_CN: 他伸出两只手，把你的耳朵捂住了。
en: He puts up both hands and covers your ears.

zh_CN: 你们沿着溪水并排走了一段。
en: For a while you walk side by side along the stream.
Who is it you're looking for, in the village?

zh_CN: 你想了想南边。关于南边，你什么也不知道。
en: You think about the south. You know nothing at all about the south.

zh_CN: 他没有马上说话。有一阵子，只听得见溪水。
en: He doesn't speak at once. For a while there is only the sound of the stream.

zh_CN: 磨坊后头有间屋子，空了两年了。屋顶漏雨，门倒还结实。
en: There's a house behind the mill that's stood empty two years. The roof lets the rain in. The door's sound, though.

zh_CN: 你要是不嫌弃，先住那儿。别的，等你睡够了再说。
en: If you can put up with it, stay there for now. The rest can wait until you've slept.
You follow him toward the smoke.

zh_CN: 又湿又密，够黑，藏得住人。
en: Wet, thorny, and dark enough to hide in.

zh_CN: 人人都说它是她的。全国的路都为它封了。
en: They say it is hers. Every road in the country is closed for it.

zh_CN: 顺着水走，迟早走到有人的地方。
en: Follow water and you come to people, sooner or later.
The snow has not reached it. Not yet.

zh_CN: 在背风地和外面之间跑信。认得沼泽里的每一条路。
en: Runs letters between the Lee and the world outside. Knows every path through the bog.

zh_CN: 左键拖动单张卡牌，右键拖动整个组合
en: Left-drag one card; right-drag a whole stack
Talk to the man in the wood
